arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Recast{/c} Skills no longer break {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} at the cost of {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} per Cast.

While you have {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c}, {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skills deal {c_number}[{SF_1}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage, and you gain {c_number}[{SF_2}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Movement Speed per stack.
